exposure: glucose levels from 2-hour postload 75-g oral glucose tolerance test
cohort: The study included 11,337 pregnancies from two Danish regions whose mothers were screened for gestational diabetes between 2004 and 2018.
finding: Increased glucose levels, even below diagnostic thresholds for gestational diabetes, were associated with an increased preterm birth risk, and obesity (BMI >=30) was identified as an effect measure modifier.
gest_age: Preterm birth was defined as <37 weeks gestation.
